heuristics: Random-mapping birthday bound for the double-or-add walk: once S(S-1) >= 2r the collision probability is taken to be at least 1-exp(-1) > 0.632, and the submitted success probability 0.39 keeps slack for partition bias, useless coefficient matches and the distinguished-point storage cap.
limitations: Analytic construction; no full-size execution or independent qualification.
The only heuristic is the random-mapping collision bound stated in proof.md. The submitted success probability is the 0.39 floor, not the larger model value.
Distinguished-point inserts are capped at S/2^16 records. The cap is 16 times the model mean at rate 2^{-20}.
Conservative generic control under C=1000, not a best-known attack estimate or security bound.
